description: The one thing you hand back: a question, alone, when two readings of the report lead to opposite fixes; or the report of the change you made, when you made one. A refusal lists every problem at once, with the JSON pointer of each field.

type.description: The type of the commit; fix when you leave it out.

subject.description: The subject of the commit: one line of 1 to 72 characters, with no period at its end and no type before it (af adds the type).

root_cause.description: What was wrong, and why it produced what was reported, 1 to 4000 characters.

change.description: What you changed, 1 to 4000 characters. The commit message carries the first 2000 bytes of it.

files.description: The files you changed, each once.

path.description: A path relative to the root of the repository, with slashes. Not under .git/ or .agent-fox/.

why.description: Why the file changed, 1 to 300 characters.

tests.description: The tests that prove the change. Each path is a regular file of the tree you submit.

path.description: A regular file of the tree.

name.description: The test in the file, when it is one of several.

proves.description: What the test shows, 1 to 300 characters.

criteria.description: The acceptance criteria of the report, each with whether the change meets it. A criterion that is unmet or partial makes the pull request a draft.

evidence.description: How you know: a test, a command and what it printed.

decisions.description: Choices you made that a reviewer should know of, each at most 500 characters.

question.description: A question, and nothing else in the object: only when two readings of the report lead to opposite fixes.

options.description: No option, for an answer in words, or up to 6 options of 1 to 200 characters.

root_cause.description: What you found so far, at most 8000 characters.
